result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides, serving a mixed-use area with commercial and institutional buildings. However, the wide crossing distance across multiple lanes and parked vehicles near the crossing point increase pedestrian exposure and reduce visibility.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the image may block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, traffic signals, and marked crosswalks. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A parked vehicle on the left side is positioned very close to the intersection, potentially blocking the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground near the corner store

hazards.name: Long Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: The width of the main roadway requires pedestrians to spend significant time in the path of vehicles without a refuge island.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and curb ramps with tactile warning pads, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four or more travel lanes in a single stage without a protective median or refuge island.

hazards.name: Lack of Visible Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at the crossing to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to reduce exposure time and allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve clarity on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features a signalized crossing with sidewalks and curb ramps adjacent to an institutional building. While there is a green painted treatment on the roadway with yield markings, the lack of standard high-visibility crosswalk markings and visible pedestrian signals reduces the overall safety for walkers.

hazards.name: Lack of high-visibility crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no standard high-visibility (zebra) crosswalk markings across the main roadway, which may lead to driver confusion regarding pedestrian priority.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Large trees on the corner may obstruct the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the corner
